_comment: Cross-discipline venue knowledge base for the venue-fit checker (docs/ROADMAP.md #11). Add venues here (no code change needed). Fields: slug (unique), name, kind (conference|journal), discipline, scope (LLM-facing blurb), topics (lowercase keywords for the deterministic overlap prefilter; multi-word entries are matched as phrases), checklists (reporting standards a submission is expected to follow), desk_reject_rules (common desk-reject triggers), aliases (alternative names for lookup).

venues.name: NeurIPS
venues.scope: Neural information processing systems: machine learning theory and practice, deep learning, optimization, probabilistic methods, reinforcement learning, and neuroscience-inspired computation.

venues.name: ICML
venues.scope: International Conference on Machine Learning: novel machine-learning algorithms, theory, and their application across domains.

venues.name: ICLR
venues.scope: International Conference on Learning Representations: representation learning and deep learning, including architectures, training methods, and empirical analysis.

venues.name: AAAI
venues.scope: Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence: broad artificial intelligence including learning, reasoning, planning, knowledge representation, and multi-agent systems.

venues.name: ACL
venues.scope: Association for Computational Linguistics: natural language processing, computational linguistics, and language technologies.

venues.name: EMNLP
venues.scope: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing: empirical and data-driven approaches to NLP problems.

venues.name: CVPR
venues.scope: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition: image and video understanding, recognition, 3D vision, and visual learning.

venues.name: KDD
venues.scope: Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining: data mining, applied machine learning at scale, and knowledge discovery from large datasets.
desk_reject_rules: anonymized submission for the research track

venues.name: SIGIR
venues.scope: Information Retrieval: search, ranking, recommendation, and evaluation of information access systems.

venues.name: Nature Medicine
venues.scope: Biomedical and clinical research of broad significance: translational medicine, clinical trials, disease mechanisms, and therapeutics.
desk_reject_rules: missing ethics/IRB approval for human studies
missing trial registration for clinical trials

venues.name: The Lancet
venues.scope: Clinical medicine and global health: randomized controlled trials, epidemiology, public health, and clinical practice.
desk_reject_rules: missing ethics approval and informed consent

venues.name: Bioinformatics (OUP)
venues.scope: Computational and statistical methods for molecular biology: algorithms, tools, and analysis for genomics, proteomics, and systems biology.

venues.name: Physical Review Letters
venues.scope: Short, high-impact letters across all of physics: condensed matter, particle physics, quantum information, gravitation, and statistical physics.
desk_reject_rules: insufficient broad impact for a Letter

venues.name: Nature Physics
venues.scope: Significant advances across physics with broad interest: fundamental and applied physics, quantum technologies, and materials.
desk_reject_rules: out-of-scope for a broad physics audience

venues.name: Psychological Science
venues.scope: Empirical psychological science across cognitive, social, developmental, and clinical psychology, emphasizing methodological rigor.

venues.name: American Economic Review
venues.scope: General-interest economics: theory, applied microeconomics and macroeconomics, and empirical economics of broad significance.
checklists: AEA data and code availability policy
desk_reject_rules: data/code not archived per AEA policy
no identification strategy for empirical claims

venues.name: Nature
venues.scope: Multidisciplinary science of outstanding significance and broad interest across the natural sciences.

venues.name: Science (AAAS)
venues.scope: Multidisciplinary science reporting major advances of broad interest across all fields.

venues.name: PNAS
venues.scope: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: high-impact research across biological, physical, and social sciences.
desk_reject_rules: insufficient significance for a broad audience
